detail: build_facts_xbrl.py period_label() collapses all instant (balance-sheet) XBRL facts whose 'end' date falls in a calendar year onto a single 'FY{year}' key, with no quarter distinction. For a company mid-fiscal-year (PINS FY=Dec), this means Q1-2026 (end=2026-03-31) and Q2-2026 (end=2026-06-30) balance-sheet snapshots collide on the same 'FY2026' key. The rank tie-break (form=10-K, filed, -pref) is per-concept, so different concepts within the same synthetic 'FY2026' row can win from DIFFERENT quarter-end dates -- e.g. PINS StockholdersEquity landed as the 2026-03-31 value (2850.584M) while CashAndCashEquivalents/Assets/Liabilities landed as the 2026-06-30 value in the same row, producinng an internally inconsistent balance sheet. Only affects the newest, not-yet-fiscal-year-end quarter of each company (prior years get overwritten cleanly once the 10-K is filed and FY{year} becomes the true annual snapshot). Needs quarter-end-aware instant-fact labeling (e.g. label instant facts by the same Q/H1 rule as duration facts, using the fact's own 'end' month, not a bare FY{year}).
example: PINS Q2-2026: state/xbrl_cache/CIK0001506293.json StockholdersEquity end=2026-03-31 val=2850584000 vs Assets/Liabilities/Cash end=2026-06-30

detail: build_facts_xbrl.py CONCEPTS dict has no 'total_debt' key at all, so total_debt is NULL for every XBRL-path ticker unconditionally, not just when the filer has no debt. PINS issued its first debt (0.00% Convertible Senior Notes) in Q2-2026, tagged as 'ConvertibleDebtNoncurrent' (2026-06-30: 981,128 thousand USD). Needs a 'total_debt' entry in CONCEPTS, e.g. concepts=['DebtLongtermAndShorttermCombinedAmount','LongTermDebtNoncurrent','ConvertibleDebtNoncurrent','LongTermDebt','ShortTermBorrowings'], merged the same way as other concepts (a company may need current+noncurrent summed rather than picked, unlike the existing single-concept fields).
example: PINS Q2-2026: state/xbrl_cache/CIK0001506293.json ConvertibleDebtNoncurrent end=2026-06-30 val=981128000

detail: Follow-up to the earlier PINS period_unclear log: this is not just a 2026 edge case. build_facts_xbrl.py period_label() returns bare 'FY{year}' for EVERY instant (balance-sheet) fact regardless of quarter, so ALL quarter-end balance sheets except the one that happens to win the per-concept rank tie-break are silently dropped from core_metrics -- across the company's entire history, not just the newest quarter. For PINS, raw XBRL has StockholdersEquity (and presumably Assets/Liabilities/Cash) at every quarter-end from 2016-12-31 through 2026-06-30 (verified: 35 distinct instant dates), but core_metrics only ever had one populated shareholders_equity value per calendar year, and non-Dec-31 quarters (Q1/Q2/Q3, H1) got NULL balance-sheet columns entirely. Recommended fix: label instant facts the same way as duration facts (Q1/Q2/Q3/H1/FY by the fact's own 'end' month), not a bare FY{year}, so every quarter's balance sheet lands in its own row.
example: PINS: state/xbrl_cache/CIK0001506293.json StockholdersEquity has instant facts at every quarter-end 2016-12-31..2026-06-30, but core_metrics.shareholders_equity is NULL for every period except FY* and H1-2018 was similarly empty pre-fix

build_facts_xbrl.py's 'later filing wins' split-adjustment logic (see collect() docstring) only rescues periods that get RE-REPORTED as comparatives in a later filing. Netflix's 10-K/10-Q only carries 2-3 years of comparatives, so FY2013-FY2022 EPS/shares (7:1-split-adjusted but pre-10:1) and FY2007-FY2013-filed pre-2015 data (pre-7:1) never get a later restated value and stayed on stale share-count bases. Had to rebuild the whole EPS/shares series in this run using the fact's own 'filed' date: filed >= 2026-01-23 (first post-10:1 10-K) is correct as-is; filed before that always needs x10; and filed before 2015-07-15 (pre-7:1 split) needs a further x7 (x70 total, disambiguated by magnitude, not date, since a single filing carries multiple eras of comparatives).

Standalone Q4 duration facts stop existing in XBRL for NFLX after FY2020 (period_label()'s 9-month-YTD 10-Q branch returns None, so Q4 alone is never tagged). FY2021-FY2025 Q4 rows had to be derived as FY-minus-H1-minus-Q3 for flow metrics; EPS for those derived quarters is only an approximation (net_income / FY weighted-avg-diluted-shares), since weighted-average share counts are not additive across quarters. Consider adding FY-minus-YTD derivation as a fallback in build_facts_xbrl.py for any filer with H1+FY but no Q4.

FY2026 filing's own 'Adjusted EBITDA' reconciliation table prints an 'EBITDA' result row of (11,362) that is actually FY2025's EBITDA carried over from the prior filing (verified: -16336+102+1+1928+3124-181 = -11362, matching FY2025's OWN filing which independently states FY2025 EBITDA=-11,362). FY2026's true EBITDA (computed from its own inputs: -7581+74+0+1651+1275-449) is -5,030, near its Adjusted EBITDA of -5,038. Balance sheet splits liquid cash across 'Cash and cash equivalents' and a separate 'Term Deposit' (+accrued interest) line in FY2024-26 and H1-2021..H1-2026 filings; the extractor only captures the 'Cash and cash equivalents' line, understating true liquid cash by the term-deposit amount (e.g. H1-2022: cash line 43,957 vs term deposit 2,011,696). FY2019/FY2020 filings do NOT split them (term deposits already folded into the single cash line), so the pattern is period-dependent within the same entity.

FY2024 annual's Statement of Changes in Equity has 'Loss for the year - (812,259) (812,259)' but the extractor's statement_line match returned 0.0 for both equity-statement occurrences (line 196, 205); the correct value was only recoverable from the P&L's 'Net loss' line (also present but not picked as statement_line either -- had to read Extracted/IPR.NZ_Annual_FY2024.txt directly at line 130).

facts.units_hint says 'thousands' for this ticker but the filings are headed plain '$' (whole NZD) throughout FY2019-FY2026 -- confirmed from Statement of Financial Position headers and cross-checked against a 514.9m-share company with a ~NZ$1.5m market cap (issued capital 5,672,856 total, not billions). Another instance of the documented units_hint trap.

H1-2020 cash flow statement (interim, 30 Sept 2019) presents financing activities in pre-IFRS16 style ('Repayment of Loans' only, no separate 'Lease Payments NZ IFRS 16' or 'Principal Lease Payments' line) despite the balance sheet already carrying Lease Liability for Right of Use Assets. scripts/check_currency.py's STATED regex for JPY ('japanese yen|yen') is not anchored to a word boundary, so it false-matches the substring 'yen' inside common Vietnamese surnames (e.g. 'nguyen') that appear hundreds of times in Mainfreight's annual-report staff acknowledgements section. This causes 'functional currency...is the] yen' to spuriously match across an unrelated 40-char gap and misreports MFT.NZ as JPY when the filings are unambiguously NZD (140 NZ$ / 'NZ$000' markers vs 2 USD, 12 EUR from segment disclosures, explicit 'rounded to the nearest thousand dollars ($000)' + 'presentation currency of the Group is New Zealand dollars' statement). Needs a word-boundary fix, e.g. r'(?<![a-z])yen(?![a-z])', or requiring 'japanese' before 'yen'.
example: MFT.NZ_Annual_FY2026.txt: 'functional currency ... is ... nguyen' false match; true statement at 'The presentation currency of the Group is New Zealand dollars ($)'

detail: BaseParser Q2/Q3 tanshin two-column tables (prior-year then current-year) are inconsistently ordered across filing vintages -- some Quarterly_Q2-20xx.txt files put current-period first, others put prior-year first, with no reliable positional rule. build_facts.py's prior_year_column/statement_line labels got this backwards for at least one period (Revenue Q2-2023: facts table labeled 231,124 as statement_line/current when the filing's own income statement two rows down shows 266,927 is the six-months-ended-Sept-2022 (current) figure). Had to cross-check the top-of-document 'Consolidated operating results' summary table (which names each column's period explicitly) against the later full income-statement table for every H1/Q1/Q3 file.

Japanese kessan-tanshin 'Number of issued shares'/'Number of treasury shares'/'Average number of shares outstanding' block (near the Notes section, e.g. Annual_FY2026.txt:108-119) is never captured by the generic BaseParser -- facts table had zero SharesOutstanding candidates across all 36 files despite every Annual/Quarterly file containing this block. Had to hand-extract for all 27 periods (issued minus treasury, or the disclosed weighted-average).

H1 FY2026 kessan-tanshin (6995.T_Quarterly_Q2-2026.txt) omits the interim Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows entirely (Japan eased interim CF disclosure requirements circa 2024-25) -- OperatingCashFlow/CapEx/FreeCashFlow/Depreciation and period-end CashAndEquivalents are genuinely absent from the source document, not an extraction miss. All total_debt candidates are small note-table fragments (19748, 6071, 13014, 20142) rather than borrowings totals. Debt must be summed from the balance sheet: current 'Bank and other debts' + non-current 'Bank and other debts' + current and non-current 'Lease liabilities' (+ loans from non-controlling shareholders). Also note total_assets: the worksheet resolved 'Total assets LESS current liabilities' (FY2024=1112542 coincidentally close, FY2025=1019996) as total_assets; true total assets is a separate Ten Year Summary line (FY2025=1155673).

check_currency.py flags HKD as 'expected JPY' because the prose pattern 'japanese yen|yen' matches CK Hutchison's Japan-operations narrative; symbol counts are HKDx829 vs zero yen signs. The word pattern should not outvote symbol counts.
Worksheet Filings table hints 'thousands' for Annual_FY2018/FY2019 but both statements are explicitly headed '$ million'; all ten filings are HK$ millions

Scanner ranked note-level aggregates (18623/15832/16118/21458 = combined JV/associate turnover in the segment note) alongside the true income-statement Revenue line (1555/1348/771). Holding-company revenue is an order of magnitude smaller than net income here, so magnitude heuristics mis-rank it

Two candidates per year: 'Cash generated from operations' (547) vs 'Net cash generated from operating activities' (884). The subtotal is the correct OCF; scanner proposed the former for FY2019/FY2024/FY2025
Scanner proposed the OPENING balance ('Cash and cash equivalents at 1 January', 2733) rather than the closing 'at 31 December' figure (2141) for FY2024/FY2025 and H1 rows

FY2024/FY2025 income statements dropped the 'Operating profit' subtotal entirely; it must be derived as Revenue + Other net income + Other operating costs. Worksheet's resolved 666/540 were right but unexplained
H1 filings' OCF/capex/total_debt flagged missing; they are present under wrapped two-line labels ('Net cash generated from\n operating activities') that the line-oriented scanner does not join
FY2016 row on grid has no usable source: earliest filing (Annual_FY2018) carries only FY2017 comparatives. FY2016 omitted from core_metrics rather than filled with note-table noise

HKEX half-year files got units_hint=billions and (H1-2025) currency=CNY from prose; the statement column header actually reads 'HK$ Million'. Both HalfYear files affected; every H1 value would be 1000x wrong if the hint were trusted.

Note-reference column ('7') captured as EPS for 8 periods; real EPS sits one line below on a 'Basic'/'Basic and diluted' line as 'HK$2.18'/'(HK$1.05)' -- currency-prefixed and parenthesised-negative, so the number grammar misses it.

Proposal took the 'NET ASSETS'/'TOTAL EQUITY' line (incl. non-controlling interests) for all 9 FY periods; the 'Shareholders equity' line sits 3 lines lower and excludes NCI (FY2025: 146,707 vs 152,418 proposed). Overstates equity 3-6% every year.

No share count anywhere in candidates for FY2023-FY2025 (5 cells marked missing); candidates for other years (413, 111, 263, -14) are changes-in-equity movement rows, not counts. Wharf's ~3,053m shares only appear in the EPS note denominator. Derivable as attributable profit / EPS.

Two adjacent lines: 'Operating profit before depreciation, amortisation, interest and tax' (= EBITDA) and 'Operating profit' (= EBIT). Scanner ranked the EBITDA line first for all 8 FY periods. The pair is a reliable EBITDA/EBIT source if split on the 'before depreciation' qualifier.

FY2022 proposed 112 (a stray) and FY2021 balance-sheet cash differs from the cash-flow closing balance because 'Bank deposits and cash' includes non-cash-equivalent deposits. FY2024 8,964 (CF closing) vs 9,718 (balance sheet); FY2025 18,889 vs 19,868. Balance-sheet line preferred for net-debt use.

HKEX balance sheets print liabilities parenthesised (negative); all 11 candidate periods came through negative for a metric that cannot be negative. Sign should be flipped at parse time for liability/debt metrics.

Extracted/0005.HK_Annual_FY2024.txt (35,207 lines) ends at the Employee Share Plans appendix; the financial statements from page 341 of the 465-page PDF are absent (0 occurrences of 'Total assets'). Either the pages are image-only or the extraction stopped; re-extract with pdftotext -f 341 before any parser work.

Correction: pages 341+ of 0005.HK_Annual_FY2024.pdf extract as cipher text (custom font encoding without a ToUnicode map), not blank. The accounts need OCR (ocrmypdf --force-ocr on that page range) before extraction; parser changes cannot help.

Both half-year filings are named one fiscal year too early: 0016.HK_HalfYear_H1-2024.txt covers the six months to 31 Dec 2024 (=H1 FY2025, Jun-30 FY end) and H1-2025.txt covers the six months to 31 Dec 2025 (=H1 FY2026). Worksheet propagated the filename label, mislabelling ~40 half-year cells by one year.

HKEX property developers report two operating profit lines: 'Operating profit before changes in fair value of investment properties' and 'after'. Scanner resolved the AFTER-FV line for FY2018-FY2021 (e.g. FY2018 51225 vs 35453), which is not comparable with FY2022+ where the FV change is shown below operating profit. Prefer the before-FV line.

Capex is never a single line for this filer: it is 'Additions to investment properties' + 'Additions to property, plant and equipment' in investing activities. No candidate was produced for any period; worksheet Missing pointers listed only income statement/balance sheet ranges, not the cash flow investing section.

Contested candidates for total_debt were tiny note values (32, 128, 159, 337) from maturity/currency-analysis notes. The real figure is current + non-current 'Bank and other borrowings' on the balance sheet (FY2025: 14384 + 95833 = 110217), also printed as a single line in the five-year Group Financial Summary.

No share-count candidate for any period; scanner picked negative option-movement rows from the share-capital note. Count must be derived as shareholders' equity / 'Shareholders' equity per share' from the Group Financial Summary (2897.9m for FY2025).

HKEX balance sheet is a 3-column layout per date (Current | Non-current | Total) repeated for two dates. Parser picked the FIRST number on the row, which is the CURRENT-assets column, not Total. Same bug hits total_liabilities and cash_and_equivalents. FY2025 true total assets 580,775; worksheet proposed 547,221 (the current column).

For an exchange operator the income-statement top line is 'Revenue and other income' (revenue + net investment income + sundry/donation income). Parser also emits the sub-total 'Revenue' and the 'less transaction-related expenses' line as rivals, producing 6-9 competing candidates per year. Anchor on 'Revenue and other income'.

Every shares_outstanding candidate was negative: parser matched the equity line 'Shares held for Share Award Scheme' (-1,228). The real weighted average share count is in the basic-EPS note as 'Weighted average number of shares in issue less shares held for Share Award Scheme (in 000)' = 1,263,893 thousand.

Capex wording is 'Payments for purchases of fixed assets and intangible assets' in investing activities; FY2025 additionally has a separate 'Payments for acquisition of HKEX headquarters premises' line that must be added for total capex. Neither was matched -- capex was flagged missing for FY2018/FY2019/H1-2025/FY2025.
All H1 net_income candidates resolved to 0. Parser matched 'Profit attributable to:' header row (blank) instead of the 'Profit for the period' figure. H1 FY2025 = 8,562; worksheet proposed 0.

HKEX reports two OCF lines: 'Net cash inflow from principal operating activities (non-HKFRS measure)' and the HKAS-7 'Net cash inflow from operating activities'. Parser ranked the non-HKFRS one first for FY2020/FY2021/FY2025. The statutory line is the second.

HKEX balance sheet prints Current | Non-current | Total columns per date; the scanner's first numeric column is the Current sub-column, so total_assets, total_liabilities and cash_and_equivalents were the current portion in all 14 periods. Needs a header-aware column pick (take the Total column when the header row reads Current/Non-current/Total).

HKEX gaming filers print an 'Analysis of revenue' note directly under the income statement; the scanner ranks its 'Net revenue from gaming operations' subline above the 'Revenue (Note)' statement total. Every period's top revenue candidate was the gaming subline (e.g. H1 FY2025 18,578,264 instead of 23,245,975).

Adjusted EBITDA lives in the Financial Highlights table already in HKD millions (FY2025 14,502) and again in the segment note in HKD thousands (13,758,043 = Gaming segment only, not the group total). Scanner mixed the two scales and also picked quarterly sub-table rows (FY2016 candidate 2,957 is a quarter).

Only negative financing-line values (Shares purchased by the trustee) were offered as share counts. The real diluted count is 'Weighted average number of shares for calculating diluted earnings per share' in the EPS note, in absolute units (4,381,333,435).

Balance-sheet line reads 'Cash and other cash equivalents and bank deposits' in FY2024/FY2025; earlier years read 'Cash and cash equivalents and other bank deposits'. The newer word order is unmatched, so FY2024, FY2025 and H1 FY2025 came through as missing.

H1 FY2022 appears on the worksheet grid but no filing in the corpus covers it -- the oldest half-year report is H1-2024 (comparatives reach H1 2023 only). All H1 FY2022 candidates are stray note fragments; the row was left out of core_metrics.

FY2021 annual report income statement is rendered by pdftotext as two interleaved columns (a stray left-hand column repeats every figure), so 'Rental income 498' never forms a clean statement line and revenue came out missing

Two annual files share fiscal-year end June 2022 and the Dec-2022 transition stub; both were labelled FY2022, so the stub's balance sheet (298,820) overwrote the June year end (289,015). A six-month transition stub between two year-end conventions needs its own label (FY2022-6moStub)

FY2024 was taken from the H1-2025 interim comparative (3,478 = the H1 2025 half, and 229,132/441,933 pre-restatement equity/assets). The FY2025 annual report restates FY2024 (NPAT 24,880, EPS 17.75, OCF 9,018, TA 444,543). Prefer a later annual report's restated comparative over an interim's
Borrowings are split current/non-current and must be summed; NZL also carries a convertible loan (FY2023 11,980) that is debt. Scanner offered each component separately and never a total

periods.parse fails on single-digit stub lengths: 'FY2017-15mo' parses (fiscal_year=2017, months=15) but 'FY2021-7mo' and 'FY2025-8mo' return ptype=OTHER with fiscal_year=None, so sort_key=(0,0,...) and they sort to the top of the CSV instead of chronologically. The FY####-#mo regex looks to require two digits for the month count.
example: NZK.NZ_Metrics.csv: FY2021-7mo and FY2025-8mo emitted as first rows

detail: NZK.NZ changed balance date twice (Jun->Jan in 2021, Jan->Sep in 2025), producing two label shapes periods.py does not model: a 12-month year distinguished only by its end month ('FY2025Jan' = 12mo to 31 Jan 2025, taken from the FY25(Sept) annual's comparative column, coexisting with 'FY2025-8mo' = 8mo to 30 Sep 2025), and an orphan half ('H1 FY2026Jul' = 6mo to 31 Jul 2025, superseded by 'H1 FY2026' = 6mo to 31 Mar 2026 under the new Sep year-end). Both parse as ptype=OTHER/fiscal_year=None and sort first.

Filings table reported units_hint='millions' for Annual_FY2017, FY2018 and FY2023, but all three carry NZ$000 financial statements (FY2017 revenue 136,351 = NZ$136.4m). The hint appears to be picked up from the five-year summary tables at the front of the report, which are printed in millions (e.g. 'Revenue 160.3 / 143.6 / 136.4'), not from the statement scale line. All NZK filings are thousands.

EPS candidates were the weighted-average share COUNT (138,158 / 541,455 / 538,182 thousand shares) rather than the per-share amount. The share count line sits immediately above 'Basic earnings per share' in the EPS note, and the actual EPS is a dollar amount with a leading $ sign ($0.03, $(0.04)) which the number grammar seems to skip. Correct EPS is in DOLLARS for this filer.

Operating income/EBIT missing for every pre-FY2020 period because NZK's income statement has no EBIT subtotal in those years; from FY2021 the line reads '(Loss)/profit before interest and tax' and from H1-2026 'Profit /(loss) before interest and tax'. Earlier years must be derived as profit before tax less finance income plus finance costs, or left NULL.

Annual_FY2016 and HalfYear_H1-2019 extracts are heavily OCR-corrupted (scanned PDFs): digits mangled ('2419' for 2,419, '18,666     826', 'Profiloss) before tax', 'TOTAL ASSETS.  405,725  455938  140,108'), and column alignment is lost. Both periods had to be recovered from the SUCCEEDING filing's comparative column (FY2017 annual and H1-2020 interim respectively) instead. Worth flagging these two files for re-extraction with OCR.
example: NZK.NZ_Annual_FY2016.txt:2501 'Total equity - attributed to equity holders of the company  18,666  826'

detail: Scanner returned the note reference '2.1' as the revenue value for 18 of 20 periods; the note-number column sits between the label and the figures in NZME's income statement layout, so the first numeric token on the line is the note ref, not the amount.
Same note-reference capture as Revenue: eps proposed as '2.2'/'2.3' (the EPS note number) for most periods instead of the cents figure.

NZME publishes no EBIT line; the equivalent is 'Profit before finance costs, income tax and impairment of assets' (FY2019-FY2021) and in later years must be derived as PBT + finance costs + impairments. All 16 operating_income cells came back missing/contested.

Total debt needs 'Interest bearing liabilities' plus current+non-current lease liabilities (IFRS 16 from H1-2019). Scanner found neither for FY2020-FY2025; the label also varies as 'Interest-bearing liabilities' (hyphenated) in FY2025.

Share counts appear at two scales in the same filing: the EPS note gives whole units (189,631,740) while the net-tangible-assets note gives thousands (187,900). Candidates were emitted mixed without distinguishing.
H1 FY2021 OCF proposed as '4.3' (note reference) rather than 21,885.
Extracted/NZX.NZ_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt is Vulcan Steel's interim report (six months ended 31 December 2025), not NZX's; the downloader saved the wrong PDF. Re-fetch the NZX half-year.

PEB income statement has both 'Total Operating Revenue' (the true top line) and 'Total Revenue and Other Income' (adds interest income, other income, FX). Scanner ranked them as competing candidates every year; the operating line is correct.
Pre-FY2024 balance sheets have no 'Borrowings' line at all; debt is entirely IFRS-16 'Lease Liabilities' split across current and non-current. Scanner emitted no candidate rather than 0 + leases.

Weighted-average share note is a two-column table interleaved with unrelated body text by pdftotext -layout; FY2025/FY2026 yielded only '-0' dash rows. Correct values 811,736 and 944,534 (000s) sit on the same lines.

Capex is split into two cash-flow lines ('Capital Expenditure on Plant and Equipment' + 'Capital Expenditure on Intangible Assets'); scanner offers them as rival candidates instead of components to sum.

H1-2026 'HalfYear' file is an investor presentation, not interim financial statements: no statement lines, so zero candidates. Half-year figures live in a slide summary table (1H26/2H25/1H25/FY25 columns).

NZX's income statement has no EBIT line; EBIT appears only in the narrative 'Summary Financial Performance' table as 'EBIT' in $ millions. The statement runs revenue -> EBITDA -> D&A -> PBT, so operating_income must be derived or taken from the summary table.
Share count is only in the share-capital note prose: 'The Company had 328,535,448 fully paid ordinary shares as at 31 December 2025'. No statement line, so every period scanned as missing.

NZX splits cash into 'Cash and cash equivalents' plus 'Cash and cash equivalents - restricted' ($20m clearing-house) plus 'Funds held on behalf of third parties' (matched by an identical liability). The scanner sometimes picks the cash-flow-statement closing balance, which includes the restricted $20m.

H1-2026 interim restated the revenue BASIS (gross vs net), not just the value: fund-related expenses previously offset against funds management revenue are now shown in opex, lifting revenue AND opex by $5.894m (H1-2025) and $12.303m (FY2025) with zero effect on EBITDA/NPAT. The scanner ranked the older annual-report value first, so H1 2026 (gross) sat next to FY2025 (net) and implied 24.1% H1 growth vs the company's reported 13.3%. A later filing's comparative column should outrank the original when the filing declares a presentation restatement, and profit-neutral restatements need flagging as a basis break rather than a value correction.

Note-reference column ('5.1', '5.2') sits between the label and the value in Precinct's EPS/FFO rows, so the scanner captured the note number as the value. 'Basic earnings per share 5.1 0.69 (1.39)' was read as eps=5.1 for six different periods.

Same note-reference issue: 'Interest bearing liabilities 6.1 1,610.3 1,169.3' was read as total_debt=8.6/8.4/6.8. Actual debt for this REIT is 234-1610m. Also debt is split current + non-current and must be summed (FY2024 = 165.3 + 1169.3 = 1334.6).
Cash-flow line 'Operating revenue received' was preferred over income-statement 'Gross operating revenue'. FY2025: 276.8 (cash) vs 266.1 (revenue). Pre-FY2019 the label is 'Gross rental income'.

Precinct labels REIT operating earnings 'Operating income before income tax' (FY2016-FY2023) and 'Operating profit before income tax' (FY2024+); neither matched, so operating_income was missing/contested in 12 of 15 periods.

Capex is split across up to four investing lines (investment properties, development properties, other assets, PP&E); the scanner took only the first, understating FY2018 capex as 17.5 against a 266.2 total.

JGAAP-era (FY2007-FY2015) yuho-style annual reports: NetIncome/ShareholdersEquity candidates carry off-by-a-few-lines context anchors, so the attributable figure is not identifiable from facts alone. The tanshin front-page summary table (lines ~12-30, '(1) 連結経営成績' with 売上高/営業利益/経常利益/当期純利益 columns) is clean and authoritative for all of revenue, operating income, net income and EPS.

Two-column IFRS cash-flow statements (prior year LEFT, current year RIGHT) are read left-column-first, so a metric's value is attributed one year late. FY2024 annual line 676 reads '自己株式の取得による支出 △7,847 －': 7,847 is FY2023 and FY2024 is nil, but facts records 7847 for FY2024.

REIT revenue line is 'Rental and management fee income'; unmatched, so revenue came up ✗ for FY2023/24/25 and H1 FY2026 and the FY2018-22 proposals were the 'Total income' line (includes IAS-40 fair-value gains, e.g. FY2021 517,151 vs 108,653 rental)

For a property REIT the capex proposal was 'Acquisition of property, plant and equipment' (-73 FY2025) which is immaterial. Real capex is 'Expenditure on investment properties - development/- stabilised' + 'Acquisition of investment properties' + 'Capitalisation of interest on development properties'

Borrowings are split between current and non-current liabilities from FY2023 on; proposals took only the non-current line (FY2023 647,049 happened to match, FY2024/25 would have missed the 150,000/100,000 current portion). Total debt needs both 'Borrowings' lines summed

PFI changed its balance date from 31 December to 30 June in 2024: the FY2024 annual report is a SIX-MONTH transition stub (1 Jan - 30 Jun 2024) and FY2025 is the 12 months to 30 Jun 2025. Worksheet labelled the stub 'FY2024' with no stub marker; FY2018-FY2023 are Dec-31 12-month years, so the series is not comparable across FY2024

EPS proposals were the note reference '4.1' (the cross-reference number in the NOTE column) rather than the cents figure, for 11 of 13 periods. Same failure gives shareholders_equity=4.2, total_debt=3.1, Depreciation=5.1, stock_based_comp=5.8/5.9 -- all note numbers from the NOTE column

Segment-note columns (Agency / Retail & Water / Other) were ranked above the group total. FY2024 proposed ebitda=12314 and operating_income=3701 are the Agency segment column; group totals are 44170 / 15355.

units_hint says 'millions' for half-year files whose statements are printed '$000' (H1-2017, H1-2020, H1-2022, H1-2024, H1-2025). Highlights commentary quotes $m, statements quote thousands; hint picks up the commentary.
PGW.NZ_HalfYear_H1-2018.txt and H1-2019.txt are both the six months to 31 Dec 2018 (duplicate filings); the worksheet maps both to H1 FY2019, so one file's candidates are redundant.
FY2023+ renamed 'Debt due within one year' to 'Working capital debt'; total debt = working capital debt + long-term debt, both needed. H1 FY2025/26 use 'Short-term debt'.
'Basic & diluted EPS' / 'Basic and diluted EPS' (single combined line, ampersand or 'and') is unmatched; all FY2020-FY2025 eps cells came back missing.

FY2026 adds a non-cash 'Land acquisition funded through deferred settlement arrangements' (19,419) disclosed under 'Significant non-cash activity' below the cash flow statement, with matching current+non-current 'Deferred settlements' liabilities (9,740 + 9,679) on the balance sheet. Cash capex therefore understates economic capex by ~19.4m, and the deferred settlements are debt-like but sit outside the 'Borrowings' lines

Kaspi has a 31-Dec fiscal year end, but adjudicate labelled every interim file one year early (HalfYear_H1-2026 -> 'H1 FY2025', Quarterly_Q3-2023 -> 'Q3 FY2022', HalfYear_H1-2025 -> 'H1 FY2024'). The files' own headers say 'For the six months ended 30 June 2026' etc. FY-end month inference appears to have picked a non-December year-end from the annual reports.

KKS.F_Annual_FY2025.txt is missing the primary consolidated statements (pages 7-12: profit or loss, financial position, cash flows). The table of contents lists them but the extracted text jumps from the auditors report straight into the notes; only note tables and the parent-only condensed statements survived. Annual FY2025 cells had to come from SEC XBRL instead.

POT splits interest-bearing debt across TWO 'Loans and borrowings' lines (non-current + current); adjudicator proposed only one tranche, understating debt ~2.4x. FY2025 non-current 192,884 + current 275,000 = 467,884; less cash 8,975 = 458,909 which matches the audited five-year summary 'Net interest-bearing debt'. Same pattern in all 16 periods.

POT labels its revenue line 'Total operating income' / 'Operating income' in the five-year summary, so the scanner mapped revenue into operating_income for FY2016-FY2021 (e.g. FY2021 338,281 is revenue, not EBIT). True EBIT is the 'Operating profit before finance costs, share of profit from Equity Accounted Investees and taxation' line.

For every half-year filing the adjudicator proposed total_assets as shareholders_equity (H1 FY2023 2,799,282 is total assets; equity is 2,089,920). The interim balance sheet prints equity and the assets total in adjacent two-column layout.
All six half-year filings were hinted 'millions' but are printed in NZ$000 (thousands), same as the annuals - e.g. total_assets 3,026,579 = NZ$3.03bn. A blanket-millions read would be 1000x low.

H1-2017 interim cash flow statement aggregates investing activities into unlabelled 'Cash inflows'/'Cash outflows' lines with no separate property-plant-equipment purchase line, so capex is genuinely undisclosed for that period.

PaySauce holds client payroll float; cash flow statement has TWO OCF lines - 'Net cash from operating activities before increase in funds due to customers and IRD' (economic OCF) and 'Net cash from operating activities' (includes float). Scanner picked the float-inclusive total for some periods and the before-float line for others, producing an inconsistent series.

Units change mid-history with no page header the scanner can read: FY2017-FY2020 and H1-2019/H1-2020 statements are in WHOLE DOLLARS (column header is bare 'NZ$' or '$'); FY2021 onward is thousands ('$000s'). units_hint reported 'thousands' for whole-dollar files and NULL for thousands files - i.e. inverted on several.

Scanner preferred the non-GAAP SaaS 'Recurring Revenue / Gross Margin' management table over the statutory 'Operating revenue' line. They coincide for PYS by luck in some years but are different definitions; gross_profit candidates all come from the non-GAAP table (no COGS line exists in the statutory P&L).

H1 FY2025 net_income proposed as 0; actual is 70 ($000s) per H1-2025 EPS note and H1-2026 comparative. Scanner picked a zero from the statement-of-changes-in-equity 'Other comprehensive income' row rather than the 'Net profit for the period' row.

EPS scale changes: FY2019/FY2020 report 'Basic loss per share (dollars per share)' (-0.020); FY2023 onward report 'Basic earnings per share (cents)' (0.19). Normalized everything to cents. Also several eps candidates are the weighted-average share count (1.41957e+08) grabbed from the adjacent line.
FY2019 total_assets scanned as 33712; statement of financial position line 1535 reads 30325 (33712 appears nowhere as a balance-sheet total; 30325 = 15112 liabilities + 15213 equity)

FY2026 balance-sheet cells (equity 17685, assets 89487, liabilities 71802) came from the PARENT-ENTITY note, not the consolidated statement; consolidated values are 105634/250082/144448 at Annual_FY2026.txt:2020-2075

TPW's P&L has no EBIT subtotal (goes straight from gross margin through expense lines to 'Profit before tax'); operating_income was missing in all 17 periods. Derivable as PBT + finance costs - interest income

SBC resolved to 0 for every annual: the cash-flow statement has no SBC add-back line. Real figure is the 'Share-based payments (note 20)' row in the statement of CHANGES IN EQUITY (FY2026 4177, FY2025 4880), also in the reserves note as 'Share-based payment expense'

ASX filers publish an EBITDA reconciliation table ('RECONCILIATION OF EBITDA TO STATUTORY PROFIT BEFORE TAX') with EBITDA and Underlying EBITDA; scanner picked  summary-table values for FY2019-21 and missed half-years entirely
Weighted average share counts sit in the EPS note as 'Weighted average number of ordinary shares used in calculating basic earnings per share'; missing for 14 of 17 periods
TSXV filer labels revenue 'Net revenues from contracts with customers' (IFRS 15) and, pre-FY2018, 'Net Revenues'. Neither matched, leaving revenue missing/contested on nearly every period.

Interim income statements switched column order at FY2019: FY2015-FY2018 print YTD columns FIRST then three-month ('Six months ended June 30, | Three months ended June 30,'); FY2019+ print three-month first. Taking column 0 unconditionally yields YTD values labelled as a quarter - Q3 2015 revenue reads 11.5M instead of 4.6M. Order must be read from the statement's own column header, not assumed.

In FY2018 interims the revenue label line wraps: the label line carries only the prior-year three-month figure and the continuation line carries [YTD_cur, YTD_prior, 3mo_cur]. A single-line scan pairs the label with the wrong column.

Statements are in WHOLE Canadian dollars ('(Expressed in Canadian Dollars)', FY2025 revenue prints 43,051,983). units_hint reported ['millions','thousands'] for this ticker - both wrong, picked up from MD&A/presentation prose rather than the statement pages. Whole-dollar filers appear to have no hint rule.

Weighted-average share counts sit in the EPS note under bare 'Basic'/'Diluted' subheadings with the shared label 'Weighted average number of shares outstanding' (annuals) or 'Weighted average number of shares' (some interims), and in newer interims the label wraps so the numbers land on the following line.

OCF label varies with sign: 'Cash provided by operating activities', 'Cash (used in) provided by operating activities', 'Cash (used in) / provided by operating activities'. Only the plain form matched.
Pre-FY2019 label is 'Net Income After Income Taxes'; FY2018 interims use lowercase singular 'Net income after income tax'. Case- and plural-sensitive patterns missed the FY2018 quarters entirely.
capex is split across two lines 'Payments for the purchase of property, plant and equipment' and 'Payments for village developments'; both must be summed. Extractor found neither for FY2020-FY2026.
note reference numbers in the NOTE column (2.1, 2.2, 4.2, 3.3) are being picked up as metric values; every RAD revenue/eps/total_debt candidate ranked a note ref first

FY2019/FY2020 annuals are OCR'd scans with corrupted digits ('12,868' for net assets 17,868; '——1.925' for OCF 7,925); statement-line values from these two files need cross-checking against later comparatives

NZX filers present 'Revenue from contracts with customers' then 'Other income' then 'Total revenue and other income'; the scanner offered the Total line (incl. a 5.85m fair-value gain in FY2023) as an equal-ranked candidate. The contract-revenue line should outrank any 'Total revenue and other income' subtotal.

Only candidate found is the KMP-compensation note ('Share-based payment expense' inside key management personnel compensation), not a group total. Statement of changes in equity share-option-reserve movement would be a better source.

Closing share count appears only as 'Number of shares issued at balance date' in the NTA-per-share governance table; the scanner instead offered weighted-average EPS denominators and option-pool counts.

All six RUA.NZ filings report in WHOLE New Zealand dollars with no units statement on the statement pages, so units_hint is NULL for every file; magnitude (share capital 48,166,039 for a ~NZm market cap) is the only signal.

Every RYM.NZ half-year filename is one fiscal year behind the period it covers (Mar-31 FY end). HalfYear_H1-2019.txt covers six months ended 30 Sep 2019 = H1 FY2020; H1-2022.txt = H1 FY2023; H1-2024.txt = H1 FY2025. The worksheet accepted most filenames verbatim and only flagged H1-2025. H1-2018.txt is a Sep-2018 presentation = H1 FY2019.

Face-of-income-statement EBITDA subtotal was outranked by segment/underlying EBITDA tables in the narrative review section. FY2022 face subtotal 68,516 but proposal was 77,893; FY2023 53,675 vs 67,514; FY2021 71,619 vs 73,793.

Share count sits in the EPS note as 'Weighted average number of Ordinary Shares for diluted earnings per share'; also 'calculated on the basis of N shares' in older filings. Marked missing for FY2018-FY2025 despite being present.
HalfYear H1-2016/2017/2018 files carry units_hint 'millions' but statements are in $000's (cost_of_revenue -126,368 = -126.4m). All SCL filings are thousands.

Scales prints the gross-profit subtotal as a bare number on an unlabelled line directly under 'Cost of sales' (no caption). Marked missing across nearly all periods; derivable as revenue + cost_of_sales.

Only one of the four borrowing lines was picked. Debt = current borrowings + current lease liability + non-current borrowings + non-current lease liability (IFRS-16 leases are large here: FY2025 total 262.4m vs proposed 63,759).

Half-year filings H1-2011..H1-2018 got units_hint 'millions' but statements are $'000s (e.g. Revenue 21,775 = NZ$21.8m). A 1000x error if trusted; annual files in the same folder correctly hint thousands.

total_assets and total_liabilities resolved to the SAME value on 20+ periods (both took the 'TOTAL ASSETS' line). Scott's balance sheet ends 'TOTAL LIABILITIES AND EQUITY' which equals total assets; the real TOTAL LIABILITIES is the sum of TOTAL CURRENT + TOTAL NON-CURRENT LIABILITIES and is often not printed as one line.

net_income and eps candidates picked the attributable-to-parent $'000s figure as EPS (eps FY2025=14371, FY2023=15522, H1 FY2026=4344). Actual EPS sits under a 'Cents per share' header a few lines lower (17.4 / 19.3 / 5.2). Scanner should require a cents-per-share header proximity for eps.

EBITDA label wraps across two lines ('OPERATING EARNINGS BEFORE INTEREST, TAX,' / 'DEPRECIATION AND AMORTISATION (EBITDA)') so the value sits on the FIRST line while the matched keyword is on the second. Caused ebitda misses/negatives (H1 FY2021 read -3183, actual 11180).
total_debt never matched. Scott has no single debt line: it is Borrowings + Current portion of borrowings + Lease liabilities (current+non-current) + Bank overdraft, spread across the balance sheet.

ADYEY (ADR sibling of ADYEN.AS) CSV still ends at FY2025. The H1-2026 letter is now staged in research/ADYEY/PDFs+Extracted (28-Aug-2026) but ADYEY's core_metrics/CSV were not rebuilt -- that ticker needs its own parser pass to pick up H1 2026.

Adyen presents the balance sheet equity-BEFORE-liabilities, so there is no 'Total liabilities' line; the only total after the liability lines is the footing 'Total liabilities and equity' (= total assets). The adjudicator proposed that footing as total_liabilities for all 19 H1/H2 rows, giving total_assets == total_liabilities identically -- two independently-extracted subtotals agreeing to the digit is the signature. Correct value must be DERIVED as assets - equity. Caught and fixed for H1 2026; a general check for total_assets == total_liabilities would catch this class on any equity-first filer.

EBIT line wording 'Profit for the period before tax, finance costs and share of net profit of associates' wraps across two lines in pdftotext -layout, so the number sits on the NEXT line and no operating_income candidate is produced for any half-year.

Gross borrowings are labelled 'Interest-bearing loans and borrowings' (balance sheet, hyphenated) and 'Interest bearing loans' / 'Bank loans - carrying amount' (notes). SkyCity capex wording varies by era and was never matched: 'Purchase of/proceeds from property, plant and equipment' (FY2016-18), 'Net purchase of property, plant and equipment' (FY2020), 'Capital additions' (FY2022+ and all half-years). Capex = that line + 'Payments for/Purchased intangible assets'.

total_debt needs summing four separate balance-sheet lines: current + non-current 'Interest bearing liabilities' plus current + non-current 'Lease liabilities' (leases from FY2020 under NZ IFRS 16). Scanner proposed 0 for FY2021 and a note reference (7506) for FY2020.

Statutory EBITDA subtotal label wraps across two lines in FY2019-FY2022 income statements ('Earnings Before Interest, Tax, Depreciation' / newline / 'and Amortisation Expenses (EBITDA)') with the value on the intervening line, so it was missed; scanner instead surfaced *normalised* EBITDA from MD&A prose, which is a different basis.

EPS candidates picked the prior-period comparative column: H1 FY2023 proposed -4.5 (that is H1 FY2022) when the period's own EPS is 3.0. Also FY2019 proposed 23.8 = continuing-operations EPS; total incl. discontinued is 21.4.
FY2020 cash proposed as 26, which is the note cross-reference in the 'NOTES' column ('14, 26'), not the value; actual cash is 54,224.

Segment-note product line (e.g. 'Sky Box' column) outranked total revenue in the disaggregation note; H1 FY2024 proposed 255001 vs actual total 392687, H1 FY2026 proposed 225252 vs actual 414439. The revenue-by-segment table's first numeric column is not group revenue.

Underlying/non-GAAP NPAT from the MD&A summary table outranked statutory profit for the period; H1 FY2026 proposed 19.3 (underlying, NZD m) vs statutory 52429 (NZD 000, includes 34.4m bargain-purchase gain on Discovery NZ).

From FY2022 Sky's income statement drops the explicit 'Operating profit' line and runs revenue -> total expenses -> finance -> profit before tax. EBIT must be derived as revenue + other income - total expenses; no line matches, so cells read as missing FY2022-H1 FY2026.

Post-FY2023 Sky has zero interest-bearing borrowings; debt is lease liabilities only, split current/non-current as 'Lease liabilities' and never summed. Scanner picked stray note values (0, -289, 458). The five-year summary line 'Interest bearing loans and liabilities' is the reliable combined series.

Weighted-average shares outranked shares on issue at balance date; FY2023 proposed 156778 (weighted) vs 143852 actually on issue. Divergence is large in buyback years and across the FY2020 raise / Sept-2021 1-for-10 consolidation.

MD&A 'Financial performance data' summary tables carry PAIRED underlying and reported columns for the same year, with no header distinguishing them in pdftotext output. The scanner picked whichever column came first, inconsistently across years: FY2016 got reported 325.3, FY2021 got underlying 185.9 (reported 186.4), FY2023 got underlying 156.4 (reported 148.5), FY2025 got underlying 148.5 (reported 120.6). Mixing bases down one column is invisible in the values themselves. Safer to derive EBITDA as EBIT + D&A from the income statement than to read the summary table.

Adjudicator picked 'Cash flow generated/(used) by operating activities before change in working capital' (1,009,250 FY2025) instead of the true OCF line 'Cash flow generated/(used) by operating activities' (596,897). The subtotal appears FIRST in Recordati cash flow statements and matches the metric regex; the real OCF line is identical wording minus the 'before change in working capital' suffix. Need to prefer the LAST/most-indented match or explicitly exclude 'before change in working capital'.

TotalLiabilities candidates are note subtotals (FY2025: 357,067) not the balance-sheet total. Recordati's balance sheet has no single 'Total liabilities' line -- it prints 'Total non-current liabilities' (2,279,821) + 'Total current liabilities' (1,052,682) and then 'Total shareholders equity and liabilities'. Must sum the two or derive assets-equity.
SBC wording is 'Equity-settled share-based payment transactions' in the cash flow statement (16,545 FY2025). Extractor instead matched a small note figure (2,401) that is not the group SBC charge.
No capex candidates at all. Recordati splits capex into 'Investments in property, plant and equipment' and 'Investments in intangible assets' with no combined line.
No total_debt candidates. Debt lines are 'Loans - due after one year', 'Loans - due within one year' and 'Short-term debts to banks and other lenders'; the word 'borrowings' never appears.

UCB (Euronext Brussels) prints thousands separators as a NON-BREAKING/regular SPACE ('3 246' = 3246, '-1 037' = -1037). The number grammar splits on the space and captures only the trailing fragment, so essentially every candidate in facts is a truncated tail: revenue FY2015 recorded as 246 (true 3876 -> from '3 876'), total_debt 466, gross_profit 108. All 3256 candidates for this ticker are affected; the worksheet was unusable and every cell had to be re-read from the filings. Needs a number token rule allowing [ \u00a0\u202f] as a group separator for EU-style filings.

Segment revenue columns (GameRevenue, YoudaoRevenue, CloudMusicRevenue, InnovativeRevenue) are not in schema.PROMOTE_KPIS, so kpis-table corrections cannot reach the CSV: export_csv carries the stale legacy CSV cell and a carried value always beats a promoted one. 9999.HK Q1/Q2 2025 had game/Youdao/CloudMusic revenue mis-assigned (GameRevenue=1254.0 vs actual 24048.0) and could only be fixed by editing the CSV cells directly.
neither XBRL nor text extraction produced facts; agent fell back to reading filings directly

52/53-week retail calendar ending the Sunday nearest Dec-31: FY ends in early JANUARY of the following calendar year (FY2016 ended 2017-01-01, FY2020 ended 2021-01-03, FY2021 ended 2022-01-02, FY2022 ended 2023-01-01). period_from_text assigned the January calendar year, shifting 4 annual files a full fiscal year forward vs their (correct) filenames. Rule needed: an early-January year-end belongs to the PRIOR fiscal year.
example: AD.AS_Annual_FY2022.txt (own period read as FY2023; statements say 'year ended January 1, 2023' = FY2022)

Period-end issued share count lives in the CAPITAL AND RESERVES note table ('Balance at 30 June 2024 - fully paid  206,468,935'). Scanner instead picked weighted-average-EPS-note figures in thousands, mixing scales (132,637 vs 206,468,935).
units_hint says millions (FY2021/22/24) and thousands (FY2025) but statements are WHOLE AUD ('$' column heading). Hints come from PFS/presentation PDFs quoting A$m NPVs in the same corpus.

FY2025 'Results from operating activities' extracts as (3,3717,036) - a pdftotext digit-doubling artifact. True value -3,317,036, confirmed by both the component sum and the reconciliation to loss before tax.

Euronext URD income statements print prior-year and current-year columns side by side; the scanner consistently assigned the LEFT (prior-year) column to the current FY, shifting eps/net_income/operating_income one year for every annual (FY2025 eps proposed 9.82 = FY2024 actual 9.46)

Half-year reports print three columns (prior FY, prior H1, current H1); the scanner took column 2 (prior H1) as the current half, e.g. H1 FY2023 OCF proposed 569 which is H1 FY2022; current-half value is always the RIGHTMOST column

Wording 'Net cash inflow / (outflow) from operating activities' with a slashed inflow/outflow variant is missed; scanner fell back to a five-year-summary millions value (FY2025 proposed 233, statement is 165,522 thousands = 165.5m; FY2019 proposed 16.4, statement 136,698).

Annual reports open with a five-year 'Key financial metrics (in millions)' review table whose columns are FY-4..FY; the scanner reads those millions values as the current period (FY2016 proposed 376.8, statement 546,866 thousands). Statement-section revenue should outrank summary-section.

total_debt candidates only capture current 'Loans and borrowings'; non-current loans and borrowings plus current/non-current lease liabilities are never summed, understating debt ~40% (FY2024: 369,701 proposed vs 615,035 all-in).
REIT has no 'Revenue'/'Total revenue' line; top line is 'Gross rental income' plus 'Management fee income'. Revenue was missing for every one of 16 periods.

Contested shortlists ranked the Industre joint-venture 'Summarised Statement of Financial Position' note above the group consolidated balance sheet for every H1 (H1 FY2022 proposed 499,587 vs the true group 1,595,010). Two-column pdftotext -layout pages put the balance sheet in the right half, so 'Bank borrowings' and 'Borrowings' never start a line and are missed; proposals fell back to note fragments (6.4, 7.3, 8.5) instead of the borrowings balance.

revenue candidates came from the A3 revenue-disaggregation note (by category/segment/timing), not the P&L 'Sales revenue' line. Note sub-totals are ~40-60% of true revenue: proposed FY2023 356,285 vs actual 589,078; FY2025 228,875 vs 385,389; H1 FY2025 114,664 vs 196,027

every shareholders_equity candidate was the Total assets figure. net_income matched 'Profit before tax' lines. FY2023 proposal 16,997 was right by luck but FY2021 16,123 and FY2020 -60,013 came off mixed rows; the correct wording is 'Profit for the year/period attributable to owners of the company'

operating_income/ebitda candidates were taken from the 5-YEAR FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE summary table's 'Depreciation and amortisation' row rather than the EBIT row; the 5yr table is actually a good source but the row offset is wrong

shares_outstanding matched the EPS note's 'Weighted average number of shares'. Actual issued shares are in the shareholder-information section as 'Ordinary shares fully paid' under 'Issued shares in the company at 30 June YYYY comprise:'

total_liabilities was ✗ for 10 of 15 periods: NZX balance sheets never print a 'Total liabilities' line, only current and non-current subtotals. Derive as total_assets - total_equity, or sum the two unlabelled subtotals

HalfYear_H1-2017..H1-2020 files are the interim to 31 Dec of the NAMED year, i.e. one fiscal year LATER than the worksheet assigned (H1-2017 = six months to 31 Dec 2017 = H1 FY2018). Savor annual reports are two-column magazine layout; pdftotext -layout interleaves the balance sheet with an adjacent notes column, so the scanner pairs each number with the label one-to-two rows away. EPS candidates picked up the weighted-average-shares line (61753/66602/76008) instead of the 'Basic and diluted' cents figure two rows above; EPS is in CENTS for this filer.

Investment trust SOCI has Revenue/Capital/Total columns; scanner proposed the Revenue-return column as net_income for every year. Total column is the profit and loss account (FY2026: 758,536 not 52,733).
units_hint said 'billions' for 6 of 9 annuals; statements are headed £'000 throughout. Hint drove the ~ / ? ranking.

Shares ex-treasury are only in the share-capital note ('Closing Ordinary Shares of 5 Pence'); scanner picked authorised/total-incl-treasury counts. Derivable exactly as equity/NAV-pence-per-share.

No candidate combined loans and borrowings with lease liabilities. IFRS-16 leases are ~45% of TGG total debt (FY2025: 194.8m loans vs 210.7m leases) and appear as four separate lines (current/non-current x loans/leases). Scanner picked single lines only.

Scanner picked the cash-flow line 'Net income tax paid' (-17,444 FY2025 / -10,057 FY2024) as net_income. True profit for the year is -25,774 / 39,376 from the statement of comprehensive income. Pattern must not match 'income tax paid'.
thl labels EBIT as 'Operating profit before financing costs' (sometimes '(loss)/profit'); unmatched in every annual/interim, giving 14 missing operating_income cells.

shareholders_equity proposals equal total_assets for FY2023 (1,343,570) and H1 FY2023 (1,159,472); thl prints Equity mid-page in a two-column layout so the scanner grabs the assets total. Correct FY2023 equity is 610,955.
